summary: Exact attempted loader/kernel identities and linked symbols inspected. Loader log resets per initialization and saturates; earliest guard/DTB paths precede it. Kernel ring is image-owned, wraps and lacks reset retention. Offline extractor can truncate reused output. No incident runtime log or qualified transport exists.
limitations: Source/link review only; no new hardware execution or memory probing.
No proof of how far the failed boot ran, no recovered XNU log.
NAT-016 archives received data; NAT-017 must qualify an actual channel and reset retention before further native testing.
